title: APS Locale Authority and Same-Route Release Bridge
purpose: Adopt the completed VAP-L10N R1-R5 vertical slice as the governed locale-release pattern inside Article Production Simplification, so locale work becomes part of the article pipeline instead of a separate operator phase.

mappingFromVapL10n.rule: Each locale requires its own Candidate lineage plus explicit Human Review, Human Approval and Human Publication Decision.
CAR retains visual publication authority. A language-free published physical figure may be reused without binary duplication while locale-specific alt/caption projection remains governed.
CPR retains presentation authority and preserves the same presentation identity/PDS contract across locale projections.
VAP retains Visual Article release projection authority and binds only already-governed locale content, CAR assets and CPR presentation.
The canonical article route is shared across locales; runtime locale selection chooses the published locale record without duplicating the route.

projectionAuthority.localeArticleAuthorityOwner: Published Knowledge Authority / locale successor authority

apsHandoffs.APS-4: Resolve/reuse Candidate and expose per-locale readiness/blockers.
apsHandoffs.APS-5: Assemble Human Review/Approval evidence per locale, reusing exact digest-bound evidence where it already exists.
apsHandoffs.APS-6: Collect explicit per-node/per-locale Human decisions; Publication remains explicit and independent by locale.
apsHandoffs.publicationBridgeSuccessor: After locale article authority exists, automatically hand off to CAR → CPR → Visual Article → same-route locale release without requiring separate VAP-L10N operator choreography.
